g.text: Guest checkout: OTP or password for returning users?
Arjun shared two options with effort estimates. OTP: 3 days, lower drop off in last test.
Password: 1 day, but 12% higher abandonment in the 2025 experiment.
Pick OTP or password and reply in #checkout-eng. Three tickets are waiting on this.
Need a call on returning guest auth. Option A OTP (3 days), Option B password (1 day).
Bumping this. It blocks CHK-414, CHK-415 and CHK-417.
Ananya, any chance of a decision this morning? We plan sprint scope at 12.
One Tap Pay general availability on Thu 22
